config.resultOrder: seed, kickoff white/black, candidate color white/black

uncertainty.note: Whole seed groups are resampled; with few distinct seeds, these intervals can be unstable and are not a proof of strength.

promotionGate.note: A fixed screening gate, not a statistical proof of strength. Short-horizon or reduced-budget development runs cannot promote a model.

summary.note: Four scenarios per seed swap candidate color and kickoff. Goals/shots exclude any legal Casual warmup. Artificial horizons are not full timed matches; pending shots always resolve. Policies see a constant hidden RNG state.
